events.event_identity: One Lokken class-action controversy concerning UnitedHealth/naviHealth and nH Predict in Medicare Advantage post-acute care. The complaint, its news reports and later discussion count as one event. It is distinct from the unrelated February 2024 Change Healthcare cyberattack and the separate Humana lawsuit.
events.cutoff_rule: Arctic Shift historical title witness captured at 2023-11-15T21:22:18Z plus the existing 30-minute margin.
events.input_text: A class-action complaint filed on November 14, 2023 alleges that UnitedHealth, UnitedHealthcare and naviHealth used the nH Predict algorithm in Medicare Advantage post-acute care decisions, overriding treating clinicians and denying coverage for care the plaintiffs say was medically necessary. The complaint's claims remain allegations, not findings. A contemporaneous STAT investigation published November 14 separately reported employee pressure to follow algorithmic rehabilitation-stay projections. No later filing, response, ruling or outcome is included.
events.input_text_kind: Time-bounded human summary of the fixed complaint, contemporaneous STAT report and cutoff headline; allegations are attributed.
